services.desc: Skydiving is transformative. If you’re one of the thousands of folks that have jumped with us, you know exactly what we’re talking about. And if you haven’t jumped yet… buckle up for the most awe-inspiring experience of your life. Come jump at SCC! We are the premier destination for tandem skydiving near Myrtle Beach and Wilmington, NC. Our professional instructors are highly trained, our facilities are top-notch, and our views are stellar. Plus, we offer the opportunity to land on the beach or at our dropzone! Whether it’s your first jump or your first of many, we’re thrilled to have you at Skydive Coastal Carolinas. We can’t wait to support you on your skydiving journey! From the ground,

blurb: Guests sign a waiver, watch an informational video, meet their instructor, and get briefed. They fly up in an aircraft enjoying views of the Atlantic Ocean, Oak Island Lighthouse, and Bald Head Islands. They freefall for 45 to 60 seconds at 120 mph, then float under a parachute for 5 to 7 minutes before landing.
